observations.behavior: Adds the conversations endpoint with its own set of incremental fields and report-specific parameters.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects Gladly's conversation export to PostHog warehouse ingestion; this hunk establishes the configuration.

observations.behavior: Assigns an explicit 7-day backfill lookback to the conversations table while other tables use defaults.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes how incremental syncs read history for conversations, potentially affecting data freshness and retention behavior.

observations.behavior: Tests that conversation rows retain their natural primary key without injected _row_id and preserve metadata like status and timestamps.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection against changes in row structure or identity handling for the new conversations stream.

observations.limitations: Only three hunks were examined. No runtime execution or end-to-end test results are available. Tier assignment relies on static inspection rather than observed benefit.

review.limitations: Only three hunks were examined. No runtime execution or end-to-end test results are available. Tier assignment relies on static inspection rather than observed benefit.
review.reason: The change adds a bounded capability: importing Gladly conversations as records with restatement support, including cursor selection, windowing, and tests. This is substantive but not systemic across multiple components.
review.posthog_relevance: Adds customer service context (conversations) to warehouse queries, which could help users correlate support activity with product events.
review.uncertainty: Assessment does not account for compatibility, adoption, or downstream query performance; tier 3 requires broader systemic impact.
